description: Local trigger and behavior evals for the research-session-workflow skill.

trigger_cases.prompt: That eval finished — log the EXP entry in EXPERIMENT_LOG.md, add the NOTE on our design decision, and cite the baseline paper.
Let's start a research session to investigate timing drift and record our findings in the lab notebook.
Run ruff format on tests/audit_agent_brain_test.py and check pytest locally.

behavior_cases.prompt: An offline eval finished and used the Beat This! beat tracker baseline. Should we ask the user first before writing EXP- and PAPER_LEDGER entries, and should we log this run in PAPER_OUTLINE.md too?
rubric: Logs EXP- and PAPER_LEDGER.md/paper.bib in the same turn with a system-clock timestamp without asking the user to approve logging.
Explains that PAPER_OUTLINE.md is only for promoted paper-worthy results when drafting, not every individual run.
